verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no built-in AI assistant inside the PlayCanvas Editor. What it does document is an MCP server that lets external AI assistants control an open Editor session, plus PlayCanvas Skills for third-party AI coding agents. Both are integration points for outside agents, not an in-product assistant, so they are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
